title: Fly.io Deployment Pack — Clinical Co-Pilot (PR-02)
scope_summary: This document is an operational deployment guide for shipping Clinical Co-Pilot (OpenEMR) to Fly.io using a two-app topology. It maps packaged files into target repository locations and provides one-shot setup, deploy, verification, and teardown commands. It also explains key architecture and security rationale, including private-only MariaDB exposure and app separation. The guide records post-deploy checks and known limitations for MVP operations.
key_decisions_or_requirements: Deploy with two Fly apps: `clinical-copilot` for OpenEMR and `clinical-copilot-db` for MariaDB.
Keep MariaDB private by omitting a public service block and using `clinical-copilot-db.internal:3306` over Fly private networking.
Create and attach persistent volumes separately for app data (`openemr_sites`) and database data (`mariadb_data`).
Provision database app first, then application app, and inject DB credentials into the OpenEMR app via Fly secrets.
Run post-deploy smoke tests with `tests/integration/test_deployment.py` and update `README.md` with the live deployed URL.
